title: Grateful Dead Live at P.N.E. Coliseum on 1973-06-22
taper: Main source discs provided by Andy Lemieux.

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture featuring an astonishing "The Other One" performance in a variable, intense show.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers great‑sounding, clear audio that showcases a truly remarkable rendition of "The Other One," which the reviewer calls one of the most astonishing they've ever heard. The set is described as variable and intense, indicating dynamic shifts throughout the concert. Overall it’s a high‑quality soundboard tape of a standout Dead show.

ai_rating.rationale: Single 5‑star review praises both the performance (especially "The Other One") and the sound quality, suggesting an excellent show captured on a good soundboard recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer notes "Great Sound" with no reported issues; filename confirms soundboard source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Described as a variable, intense show with dynamic energy throughout.
